title: 5. 10 % of the optimal PCM
rule: N = 10 % of 104 = 10 capsules (R_in, flow, arrangement kept optimal: 10 % of the radius or flow would fall below the design-space / pump bounds).
why_not_optimal: Only 2.4 kg of PCM: the latent store is almost negligible - the ~27 kWh/yr gain is below the 28.4 kWh repeatability band, i.e. not distinguishable from a plain tank.
